Card Q&A.a: Yes. As long as your opponent has either an unsuspended level 4 or level 5 in Digimon in play, you can activate this card's effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's effect if my opponent doesn't have both an unsuspended level 4 and level 5 Digimon in play?

Card Q&A.a: 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 4 Digimon and 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 5 Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What cards are deleted by this card's [Main] effect?

Effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 4 Digimon and 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 5 Digimon.
